title: How Does Your Body Work? Heart, Lungs and Bones
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Gizmo the robot, and welcome to Gizmo Explains!
I love asking, how does that work? Today we're going to find out how your amazing body works.
We'll explore five cool things. Can you count them with me? One, two, three, four, five!
When my antenna lights up, it means I have an idea!

lines: Here's a clue: it's in your chest, and it goes thump, thump! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
Your heart is a strong muscle, about the size of your fist.
Every beat squeezes and pumps blood all around your body, from your head down to your toes!
Can you put your hand on your chest and feel the thump, thump?
Blood! It carries good things all through your body.
One more time, nice and loud: HEART!
When you run and play, your heart beats faster to keep up with you!
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: you have two of them, and they help you breathe! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
When you breathe in, air goes down a tube into your two lungs, like soft balloons.
Your body takes the fresh air it needs, and then you breathe the old air back out.
Can you take a big breath in, and slowly breathe out? Ahhh!
What do your lungs fill up with?
Air! In and out, all day and all night.
One more time, nice and loud: LUNGS!
You breathe even while you sleep, without thinking about it at all!
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: they're hard, and they hold you up! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
Bones are hard and strong, and they give your body its shape.
Grown-ups have two hundred and six bones! Without bones, you'd be floppy like a noodle.
Can you tap your knees, your elbows, and your head? Bones are inside!
How many bones do grown-ups have?
One more time, nice and loud: BONES!
Milk, cheese, and green veggies help your bones grow big and strong.
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: they help you run, jump, and smile! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
Muscles are attached to your bones, and they move them by pulling.
When a muscle gets shorter, it pulls a bone, and your arm or leg moves!
Can you bend your arm and make a strong muscle? Flex!
How do muscles move your bones?
They pull! Muscles can only pull, not push.
One more time, nice and loud: MUSCLES!
You have more than six hundred muscles. Even smiling uses muscles in your face!
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: they're white, and they help you chew! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
Your front teeth are sharp for biting, like when you bite an apple.
Your back teeth are wide and bumpy for chewing and mashing your food.
Can you show me your biggest smile? Look at those teeth!
How many baby teeth do kids have?
Twenty! Later, grown-up teeth grow in.
One more time, nice and loud: TEETH!
Brush your teeth twice a day, in the morning and at night, to keep them clean!
Now we know how it works. Great job!

recap: Wow, we learned so much! Let's remember.
Your lungs breathe air in and out.
outro: Which one was your favorite? Keep asking, how does that work?
Bye, friends! See you next time on Gizmo Explains!
